title: Plus Guarantee Refund Amount — Northgate Memberships
content:
**Article.** The guarantee refund on Northgate Memberships is the tier's Plus premium less the Annual Reward earned for the completed year, that is the reward accrued for that year less the reward reversed for that year, never below zero and rounded to the cent.

**Which year.** The completed year is the reward year of the most recent year-end Annual Reward conversion on the membership: the latest Annual Reward certificate issued on the membership, by issue date, fixes the year, and its reward year end is the end of the completed year.

**Annual Reward earned for the completed year.** The Annual Reward accrued with that reward year's end less the Annual Reward reversed with that reward year's end, rounded to the cent — the reward actually earned for that year, whatever part of it was converted or carried forward.

**Guarantee shortfall.** The tier's Plus premium less the Annual Reward earned for the completed year, rounded to the cent. A year shows a guarantee shortfall when this is above zero; a year without a guarantee shortfall pays nothing.

## Worked figures (hypothetical years on a tier whose Plus premium is 65.00)

| Annual Reward accrued for the year | Reversed for the year | Earned | Working | Guarantee refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 46.20 | 4.83 | 41.37 | 65.00 less 41.37 | 23.63 |
| 31.00 | 0.00 | 31.00 | 65.00 less 31.00 | 34.00 |
| 72.40 | 2.40 | 70.00 | 65.00 less 70.00 is below zero | nothing |
| 65.00 | 0.00 | 65.00 | no shortfall | nothing |

*Year selection (hypothetical):* a membership with certificates issued on 31 December 2025 and 31 December 2026 has as its completed year the reward year ending 31 December 2026.
